# 2 Baruch Chapter 31 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 31 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 31:2 — "all you who sow the earth / all you who work the land"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all-you-who-sow the-earth" | Literal: Syriac uses "sow" specifically |
| LOGOS | "all you who sow the earth" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "all you who work the land" | Interprets as general agricultural labor |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "all you who sow the earth" (EMET/LOGOS). The specific agricultural term "sow" is in the Syriac; it may also carry metaphorical resonance (sowing good deeds, cf. v.4-5).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 31:3 — "Zion's mother city / Zion our mother city"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Zion's-mother-[city]" | Syriac construct: "mother of Zion" = the city itself as mother |
| LOGOS | "Zion's mother city" | Formal; Zion = mother city |
| PNEUMA | "our mother city Zion" | Rephrases with possessive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "Zion our mother city" — clarifying the possessive relationship while retaining "mother city" as the key phrase.

**Status:** Resolved as hybrid.

---

## 31:5 — "depart from this age quickly / leave this age quickly"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "you-will-depart from-this-age quickly" | Literal Syriac departure verb |
| LOGOS | "you will depart from this age quickly" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "you will leave this age quickly — it won't last long" | Expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "you will depart from this age quickly, and not after a long time." The doublet in the Syriac ("quickly and not after a long time") should be preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Syriac doublet preserved.

---
